events.title: Demo Build 3: Balance update
events.summary: After updating the combat system in the last build, we’ve worked to balance it in this one. Rather than a small number of difficult to win enemy encounters, there is a larger number of more winnable ones. Other smaller changes: We’ve worked on the Almanac. events.title: Demo Build 2: New combat system and map UI
events.summary: The combat system felt a little to us, with a right and a wrong way to go about it, so we’ve reworked it to allow a lot more flexibility in who and how you fight. Almost any object can be used as a weapon now, albeit some more successfully than others. Soldiers are trained the same way as medics and engineers in this build, and even though they are better are at fighting than most, with the right weapons you can progress quite far without one.
